name: Pi-Remote
description: Remote control for your pi coding agent. Pi-Remote mirrors live pi terminal sessions to any browser, so you can watch runs, answer prompts, and send commands from your phone — end-to-end encrypted over a self-hosted relay.

capability_evidence.parallel-execution: , including switching models, changing the thinking level, compacting context, and navigating the session tree.
capability_evidence.model-routing: h incremental catch-up after a reconnect.

friction.note_en: Easy. install via npx one-liner, global npm install; needs npm install/build; configure sign-in required, server/reverse-proxy setup
friction.note_zh: 较易上手。可通过 npx one-liner、global npm install 安装；需要 npm install/build；需配置 sign-in required、server/reverse-proxy setup

analysis.summary_en: Pi-Remote attaches to a running pi session through pi's official extension API.
highlights: The extension channel (7001) binds to 127.0.0.1 by default.
QR device linking — run attach --link on the machine that runs pi; the terminal and a local window show a QR code and a pairing code.
Anyone holding the viewer token can send messages to a session, and pi runs with tool permissions.
Desktop and mobile UI — separate layouts for desktop and mobile, with six skins: Cursor, Claude, and Codex looks in dark and light.
analysis.summary_zh_native: Pi-Remote 通过 pi 官方扩展 API 接入正在运行的 pi 会话，不修改 pi 源码，不接管终端。会话始终由本机的 pi 进程持有；浏览器端看到的是同一会话的实时镜像，并可向该会话发送消息与命令，包括切换模型、调整思考级别、压缩上下文、管理会话树等。本机端支持 Windows、macOS 与 Linux，多台设备可同时接入。
highlights_zh: 扩展通道（7001）默认仅绑定 127.0.0.1；网页通道（7002）仅提供页面与 WebSocket，不提供文件接口。
双端界面：桌面与移动两种布局；Cursor、Claude、Codex 三种风格各含深、浅两套皮肤，共六套。
用量可见：Token 与费用用量随会话实时更新，显示在界面状态区。
扫码链接：在运行 pi 的电脑上执行 attach --link，终端与本地窗口出示二维码和对照码；手机扫码后在确认页核对设备信息与 2 位核对字、经管理员批准即完成链接，设备令牌自动写入本机 .env。
